name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=portrait cache / resource, descriptor=restore_portrait_cache_from_tmp). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects behavior: re-allocates the 0x32A00-byte portrait sprite cache and reloads its full image back from the FD2.TMP swap file, the symmetric read-back of the fwrite tail in fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp.
purpose: Restore the global portrait sprite cache (data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache @ 0x53A61) by reading the full 0x32A00-byte (~207KB) image back from the FD2.TMP swap file; called after FIGANI combat cinematics that freed/replaced the in-game portrait caches.
logic_summary: fp = fopen("FD2.TMP","rb"); data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache = malloc(0x32A00); fread(cache, 1, 0x32A00, fp); fclose(fp). The freshly malloc'd buffer is stored into the cache global and the same pointer is reused as the fread destination, so the global is the read target. Single basic block, no branching; fp held in callee-saved EBX across malloc/fread. The __CHK(0x18) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected. Mirrors no NULL/size checks (faithful to the vendor binary, which performs none).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache is reallocated and refilled from FD2.TMP.

notes: Disassembly cross-checked against the C source (rsrc.c:604-631): PUSH 0x18/CALL __CHK = stack probe; fopen("FD2.TMP","rb") with EBX=fp; malloc(0x32A00) result MOV [0x53A61],EAX = store to data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache; fread(EAX,1,0x32A00,EBX); fclose(EBX). The decompiler models the malloc result as a local (cache_buf) but the disassembly confirms it is stored to the global AND reused as the fread dest -- the C source correctly writes data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache directly. Source comment block (rsrc.c:604-622) already accurate, detailed, concise, ASCII-clean (notes callers, symmetric writer fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp, FIGANI context, EBX/CHK detail, malloc-to-global behavior) -- kept. Ghidra plate is shorter but fully consistent (no contradiction; it references the raw DAT_00053A61 symbol rather than the renamed global, but the meaning matches) -- left untouched per the consistency rule. Callers confirmed: fd2_execute_special_attack_skill @ 0x276ec (call site 0x27f87), fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic @ 0x28a6c (0x29098), fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence @ 0x2a6bd (0x2b59f). The 0x32A00 size and 0x53A61 cache address match the writer/allocator (fd2_load_portrait_to_cache, fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp). No logic/equivalence issues found.
